x-card.description: Catalogs, schemas and SQL reads checked by Trino's own plan. Changes wait for approval.

url.title: Coordinator URL
url.description: The coordinator, with https:// (or http:// on this computer) and its port.

engine.title: Engine
engine.description: Presto (prestodb) speaks the same protocol with X-Presto headers.

mode.title: Sign in with
x-enumTitles: No authentication (dev, or a coordinator on this computer)

user.title: User
user.description: Statements run as this user. Give it read access only wherever you can: Trino's access control is the boundary. With a JWT, empty means the token's user.

password.title: Password
password.description: Stored encrypted by GateRook. It travels over TLS only, unless the coordinator runs on this computer.

token.title: JWT
token.description: Sent as a bearer token, over TLS only unless the coordinator runs on this computer.

catalog.title: Default catalog
catalog.description: The catalog of names without one.

schema.title: Default schema
schema.description: The schema of table names without one; needs a default catalog.

catalogs.title: Catalogs
catalogs.description: The catalogs agents may use; * matches any characters. Every table Trino's plan reads must be in one of them. Empty: every catalog the user may read.

caCertificate.title: CA certificate (PEM)
caCertificate.description: Only for a private CA. Empty: the system trust store.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: A scan limit per statement. Policies set row limits and timeouts per environment.

maxScanMb.title: Data scanned per statement
maxScanMb.description: Trino stops a statement that reads more from storage (query_max_scan_physical_bytes). Trino only; empty: Trino's own limit.
